acceptanceCriteria: attempt-runner spec states a cross-attempt bound and the runner enforces it after completion evidence is retained.
Test proves runs of completed attempts are retired and live attempts are never touched.
body:
Observed 2026-10-07 by a read-only cleanup audit of the orchestrator session (code at batch 4 head 5808c26c; installed corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 build 360, corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202). Owner goal: keep Corvint lean and efficient on disk and CPU.

Documented limit, not a defect: <common>/taskman-runs/ is capped at 64 runs per attempt with 2x8 MiB output, but has no bound across attempts (docs/specs/corvint-tasks-attempt-runner-v0.md line 179). None exist on disk today. For long-running fleets this grows with every attempt.

Expected: completed attempts' run directories are retired after completion evidence is retained, within a stated total bound.

completion.reason: Delivered in PR beamfall/corvint#649 (rc3 cleanup), merged to main 2026-10-07T13:49:36Z as ce6313a015bf94d1dc675eb2130b2c2c3851c65a. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-07-v1-0931-detached-run-retirement.md, docs/decisions/0440-rc3-cleanup-requirements-accepted-2026-10-07.md and the sealed CEM .corvint/changes/48c959dbb62e0cc79ed4c81cc90a524920827e0f.cem.json at that commit (each digest is that file's sha256). The build-log entry records the change, the maintained tests and the Codex review with its repairs; decision 0440 records the owner's acceptance of ATR-V0-015. The batch passed focused package tests, go vet on darwin/linux/windows, the doc gates, dogfood check and seal, and every hosted CI check on the merge head. NOT_RUN: make gate, the live macOS update lifecycle, Linux dispatcher runtime and live dispatcher qualification. Native complete is refused with STALE_TREE (V1-0557), hence manual completion.

title: Bound detached run directories across attempts (taskman-runs is pruned per attempt only)
